label: Spotify Soft
summary: Optional soft-fail Spotify Web API status and playback.
description: Lifestyle pack. Soft Spotify Web API bridge for status, now-playing, pause, play, and track search when SPOTIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN or SPOTIFY_TOKEN is set. Presence-only status for tokens and client credentials (never returns secret values). Soft-fail without token, network.external permission, or on HTTP errors.

capabilities.label: Spotify Status
capabilities.summary: Report token/client id presence and OAuth setup tips (no secret values).

capabilities.label: Spotify Now Playing
capabilities.summary: Soft GET currently-playing track name, artists, and is_playing.

capabilities.label: Spotify Pause
capabilities.summary: Soft PUT pause on the active Spotify player.

capabilities.label: Spotify Play
capabilities.summary: Soft PUT resume/play; optional body (uris, context_uri).

capabilities.label: Spotify Search
capabilities.summary: Soft GET track search by query.

permissions.reason: Call Spotify Web API at api.spotify.com.
Detect whether SPOTIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN / SPOTIFY_TOKEN / client credentials are set (not the values).
